title: Finite-Horizon Input-Output Dynamics of Minibatch Perturbations in AdamW
abstract: arXiv:2608.19762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A minibatch can influence training beyond the update at which it is observed because AdamW stores past gradient information in its optimizer states. We study this delayed effect through paired trajectories that differ only in one gradient update and share the same subsequent training sequence. We formulate AdamW as a finite-horizon input--state--output (ISO) system whose state contains the model parameters and first- and second-moment estimates. Linearizing the joint dynamics yields a signed response operator that maps a localized gradient perturbation to its future loss effects, revealing how optimizer memory shapes their magnitude, timing, and sign. We further derive an exact multistep error decomposition and establish first-order finite-horizon accuracy under local smoothness and controlled activation switching. translated_title: AdamW中小批量扰动的有限时域输入-输出动态
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19762v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：小批量不仅影响其被观察时的更新，还会通过AdamW在优化器状态中存储的历史梯度信息影响后续训练。我们通过仅在一个梯度更新上不同且共享相同后续训练序列的配对轨迹来研究这种延迟效应。我们将AdamW表述为一个有限时域输入-状态-输出（ISO）系统，其状态包含模型参数以及一阶和二阶矩估计。对联合动力学进行线性化，得到一个有符号响应算子，该算子将局部梯度扰动映射到其未来的损失影响，揭示了优化器记忆如何塑造其幅度、时机和符号。我们进一步推导出精确的多步误差分解，并在局部光滑性和受控激活切换条件下建立了有限时域的一阶精度。实验验证了响应机制和优化器状态效应，而重复未来分析揭示了显著的影响。
tldr: 本文通过将AdamW建模为有限时域输入-状态-输出系统，首次系统地分析了小批量扰动通过优化器状态记忆对未来训练的延迟影响，并建立了精确的误差分解和理论精度保证。
en_tdlr: This paper models AdamW as a finite-horizon input-state-output system to systematically analyze how minibatch perturbations propagate through optimizer memory to affect future training, establishing exact error decompositions and first-order accuracy guarantees.
